title: Java & Spring Boot Developer Intern
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a motivated **Java & Spring Boot Developer Intern** to join our engineering team. The ideal candidate should have a good understanding of Java and be comfortable writing code using **Java and Spring Boot**. This role will provide hands-on exposure to backend development and real-world software projects.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain backend applications using **Java and Spring Boot**.
* Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code.
* Assist in developing and integrating **REST APIs**.
* Work with databases and perform basic CRUD operations.
* Debug, troubleshoot, and resolve application issues.
* Collaborate with developers, testers, and other team members.
* Participate in code reviews and follow software development best practices.
* Assist with testing and documentation of developed features.

Required Skills

* Good knowledge of **Core Java** and Object-Oriented Programming.
* Basic to good understanding of **Spring Boot**.
* Ability to write and understand backend code.
* Understanding of **REST APIs** and HTTP methods.
* Basic knowledge of **SQL and relational databases**.
* Familiarity with Git/version control is preferred.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Willingness to learn and work in a fast-paced development environment.

Education

* Pursuing or recently completed a **B.Tech/B.E./BCA/MCA** or a related degree in Computer Science/IT.
* Candidates with relevant academic projects or coding experience in Java and Spring Boot will be preferred.

What You’ll Gain

* Hands-on experience in backend development.
* Exposure to real-world fintech/product engineering projects.
* Mentorship from experienced developers.
* Experience working with APIs, databases, Git, and modern development practices.

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹15,000.00 per month

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Kolkata, West Bengal
